parties.respondent: Punjab State Power Corporation Limited & Anr.

summary: Tariff-based bidding for power procurement; interpretation of 'inter-State thermal power plant' under Mega Power Policy, 2006; customs duty exemption eligibility; pre-bid verification obligations on bidders; validity of Press Release dated 01.10.2009 affecting fiscal benefits; whether project at Rajpura (within Punjab) qualifies as inter-State; State Commission's ruling upheld; appeal dismissed.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; APTEL judgment and State Commission order upheld.
